matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies the exact same defect: Theorem 3.3's addition of an unjustified log-sum-exp normalization term that contradicts the exact derivation in Appendix B, matching the ground truth's description of an inconsistent softmax normalization term inserted into the logit-level loss formulation.

Ground truth concerns the gradient analysis in Section 3.2 (Eq. 8-9) contradicting the coupled mean-logit dependency, but finding 2 discusses a different locus (Definition 3.5, Eqs. 6-7) regarding a mismatch between soft-label CE and z_max vs z_gt, which is a different claim/equation not addressing the gradient inconsistency described in the ground truth.

Claims a contradiction between Eq. 6 and Eqs. 7-8 based on treating MaxSup's soft label as identical to the LS soft label, which appears to be a misreading of the method's intentional redefinition using z_max rather than an actual defect.
